context.body: The bounded canonical source is Jeremiah 31:27–37; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD promises sowing, rebuilding, individual accountability, a new covenant unlike the exodus covenant, instruction within, universal knowing, forgiveness, and enduring national identity under cosmic order.
observations.label: A new covenant is promised to Israel and Judah: action
A new covenant is promised to Israel and Judah: response

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 31:27–37 as prophets accuse and promise evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The new covenant is both unlike the broken covenant and addressed to the houses whose story that covenant shaped.
payload.title: A new covenant is promised to Israel and Judah
